description: Details required by Condition 4 (Submission of details - scheme of sound insulation between the retail use and residential use) of planning permission PP/25/03148 (Demolition of existing rear extensions at basement and ground floor level. Creation of a part single, part two storey, stepped rear extension at basement and ground floor level, with courtyard garden. Rear terrace at first floor level. Alterations to shopfront including removal of existing roller shutter. Retention of retail unit (Class E) over basement and ground floor and residential unit (Class C3) over basement, ground and first floor level. Associated alterations)
application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
